faq.question: What is BarCraft Appletini Mixer?
faq.answer: BarCraft Appletini Mixer is a BarCraft Crafted Cocktail Mixer made to bring the character of a well-crafted cocktail to every pour. It is bartender inspired, with the flavour profile Crisp Apple Bite: Tart green apple with juicy sweetness and a crisp finish.

faq.question: What does Appletini mixer taste like?
faq.answer: Crisp Apple Bite. Tart green apple with juicy sweetness and a crisp finish.

faq.question: How do I make a Appletini with BarCraft Mixer?
faq.answer: Simply pour 25ml BarCraft, add 25ml of your preferred spirit, finish with chilled soda and ice, and savour.

faq.question: Which spirit should I use?
faq.answer: Use your preferred spirit. Vodka is our classic pick, and gin and white rum also work well. The mixer does not include a spirit, so add your own.

faq.question: How many drinks does a bottle make?
faq.answer: One serving is 25ml, so the 550ml bottle makes about 22 servings and the 50ml bottle makes 2.

faq.question: Can I make Appletini as a mocktail?
faq.answer: Yes. Leave out the spirit and use ice, 25ml of BarCraft Appletini Mixer and chilled soda.

faq.question: What are the ingredients?
faq.answer: Water, Sugar, Glycerol [Humectant (INS 422)], Lime Juice Concentrate, Acidity Regulators [Citric Acid (INS 330), Sodium Citrate (INS 331)], Mint Extract, Natural and Nature-Identical Flavouring Substances, Sweetener [Sucralose (INS 955)], Common Salt, Preservatives [Potassium Sorbate (INS 202), Sodium Benzoate (INS 211)], Permitted Natural Colour.

faq.question: How much sugar and how many calories does it have?
faq.answer: Approximate values per 100ml are 160 kcal and 28g total sugars (all added). For one 25ml serve of the mixer that works out to about 40 kcal and 7g sugars, before any spirit or soda.

faq.question: Does it contain preservatives or sweeteners?
faq.answer: Yes. According to the label it contains the preservatives Potassium Sorbate (INS 202) and Sodium Benzoate (INS 211), and the sweetener Sucralose (INS 955).

faq.question: Which bottle size should I buy?
faq.answer: Choose the 550ml bottle for home bars, parties and regular use. Choose the 50ml bottle to try the flavour, to travel or to gift.
